name: RentSphere Delivery Service Area
scope: Custom RentSphere coverage from independent municipal/ward polygon datasets. Not an official MMR boundary, continuous 40–50 km coverage or certification of current statutory limits.
collectionLicense: Collective database of independent regional source datasets, separately extractable by areaId. DataMeet components: CC BY-SA 2.5 India; OpenCity components: Public Domain as declared by publisher; OpenStreetMap components: ODbL 1.0. No cross-source geometric union, snapping or linkage is stored.
explicitlyExcludedAreas: All locations outside the documented polygon footprints. No complete 40–50 km circle, connecting corridors, talukas or districts are implied.
verificationLimitations: No city-name validation, guessed connecting corridors, circles, bounding boxes or district/taluka substitutions.
Historical and community-mapped municipal extents may differ from present statutory boundaries.
Source repair checks preserve the even/odd areal footprint; zero-area collapsed linework is excluded.
Retain source notices and independent per-area component licences when redistributing.
